description: Vs. CPU Mode's first fight moved to stage index 0x1C (no stage-select cell) (a modified game): versus-cpu-first-fight's menu inputs up to the weapon pick (CROSS 7400), then g_fight_stage_index (0x800A36A4) poked to 0x1C at 7700, after fight_AdvanceOpponentOrder sets the opponent's stage (7649) and before the fight load reads it (7869); P1 sends no fight input, P2 is the CPU opponent, the run ends at 11000. One of the trace-cpu-nav family cpunav-*, identical but for the poked index
